Klay: ^I hope you don't hurt your neck looking down at me for so long.
^You might as well spare yourself the pain and head out now.

s: ^I have strong neck muscles, don't worry about it.
^Your eagerness for me to leave makes it less fun to actually do it.

^I probably won't be too fun though...
^I'm afraid those days are behind me.
^You should've come a little sooner hahaha...
^Back when I used to be bigger...
^I mean I can try...you're welcome to stick around! I'm just saying...

s: ^Did you just suddenly become not fun or something?

Branch5_1_13: ^Trust me, I used to be a lot more fun than this.

s: ^You used to talk with other humans?
^To mess with you for the most part.

s: ^Maybe we can put you back together somehow.
